title: Players Already Found Bigfoot in GTA 6's Swamps 🦶 #Shorts
description:
Launch day, and GTA 6 players have already found Bigfoot hiding in Leonida's swamps (Kotaku). Reports say it's Florida's own legend, the Skunk Ape, and that the encounter is south of Cottonmouth Lake, available right after free roam opens: listen for a deep growl, track it, and Jason blacks out by a strange tree while the creature approaches. Bigfoot started as a San Andreas fan myth, and Rockstar later added him to GTA 5.

Sources: Kotaku GTA 6 launch live blog (Nov 18-19, 2026), VGTimes, GAMES.GG. Encounter details are player reports. Images: official Rockstar Games trailers.

Fan channel, not affiliated with Rockstar Games.
